[quote=baladullah;60905871][spoiler=Baladullahs stance on new developments in Tirakan and Valddera, and a Call for Shamatine Cooperation][b]ATK
(Office of the Sultan, 
Ministry of Foreign Affairs, 
Ministry of Defense)[/b]

[u]Baladullah Welcomes the Developments in Tirakan and Valddera, Offers Assistance to New Governments
[/u]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم[/i]

The Islamic Sultanate of Baladullah congratulates the popular forces and their allies in [nation]Tirakan[/nation] and [nation]Valddera[/nation] in the establishment of true popular sovereignty and constitutional government in their previously fractured and war torn lands. The establishment of peace, reconciliation, and inclusive governance are critically important when any country emerges from conflict, and in shaa Allah these things will be established and consolidated by the new authorities of these countries.

We also wish to offer economic and humanitarian aid to these countries to assist them in their redevelopment and reconstruction processes. Whatever they need, we are willing and able to provide, in shaa Allah.

As a final note, we urge these countries, and all Shamatine nations, to not allow foreign interference in their politics or the establishment of any imperialist designs on our lands. It is our opinion that the expansion of the Shamatine Security Pact (SSP) and increased political, economic, and military cooperation amongst all Shamatine nations would bring all our countries great collective and individual benefits. We are not opposed to relations with the entire world, of course, and seek peaceful and mutually beneficial relations with all nations. However, as we are a Shamatine nation rooted in the culture and tradition of Shamatine peoples, we seek to uplift and assist those in our neighborhood first and foremost, so to speak. May peace be with you all.

[i]Sultan Masud al-Ayyubi
Foreign Minister Abdoul Mahonomayi
Defense Minister Musa al-Yahudiyyah[/i][/spoiler][/quote]

Tirakan shares your vision over all Shamats having to work together, and would even go so far to promote Pan-Shamatism. Greater Tirakan would like to engage in bilateral talks to get closer to Baladullah.

[spoiler=[b]World Expo 2027 - Hydronian exhibition[/b]]

The Democratic Republic of United Hydronia has announced its intentions to take part in the 2027 world expo, hosted in Naerim city, Tirakan. The government has sent a delegation consisting of the Vice President Kadri Cengiz, various officials from companies OtoHidro and Balian Technologies, including their respective CEOs, and the minister for foreign affairs Mazhal Kemalan. The governmental half of the delegation has requested to meet with their Tirikani counterparts to use the Expo to their advantage, hoping to secure a trade and diplomatic deal with the newly united nation.

President Hakan Bozkan made a speech regarding the end of the Tirikani civil war and reunification of the country the day before the delegation flew to Naerim City, formally recognising the new government and expressing the need for relations between the two east shamatine nations, especially on cooperation in the shamat sea and the ever-looming threat of Daesun. Hydronia hopes that Tirikan will see their attempts to build relations as a positive move, and even as a way for Tirikan to gain access to a wider diplomatic scope, with Hydronia offering to open up the possibility of joining the THEP partnership program to Tirikan.

Hydronias main exhibition in the 2027 world expo fits the sub-theme of defence, with the exhibition dedicated to armoured vehicle manufacturer OtoHidros latest line of military vehicles, the OH Isik II, with the star of the show being the newest variant of the vehicle, the stealth-optimised Isik II-G.

The base Isik II, which began manufacturing in 2019, is categorised as a Light Armoured Fighting Vehicle by the Hydronian army, but its versatile multi-role nature makes it easy to fulfill any job a military may have for it. The vehicle itself sports a 4x4 drive, full independent suspension and run-flat tires, allowing ease of movement over challenging terrain. The vehicle has been tested in harsh conditions too, showcasing its durability. Testing was conducted in both the far north of Hydronia, and the semi-arid conditions of Turqevia. The dimensions of the Isik II are relatively small (approximately 5.5m length x 2.5m width x 1.8m height), which further improves its mobility and versatility, whilst the vehicles weight comes in at around 13,500kg GVW, again relatively small. The Isik II comes with a modular turret system, allowing various different turrets to be mounted for different purposes. This further adds to the Isik IIs versatility, the key selling point of the vehicle. Another important feature that allows for versatility is the Isik IIs modular armour. The vehicle features adjustable protection levels which can be used for varying different missions.  The standard crew for the Isik II is 3 people; a driver, gunner and commander. A standard configuration of the Isik II running on diesel can reach a top speed of roughly 110 km/h and a range of 250km, but these factors all depend on how the vehicles various versatility features are configured. The cost to manufacture a single unit is roughly Ġ775,000, whilst the cost to buy a single unit is around Ġ820,000.

The Isik II doesnt only come in the one version though. The Isik II-E is a fully electric variant of the base vehicle which began manufacturing in 2020. Unlike ita diesel-powered counterpart, the Isik II-E is not in wide use with the Hydronian military due to its speed and range drawbacks, however it is still available for export and its electric capabilities are always improving. The vehicle features a similar 4x4 drive and full independent suspension to the base vehicle, allowing it to operate over the same challenging terrain and under the same harsh conditions. The Isik II-E runs with an advanced electric motor and battery, which compete with market rivals, but dont yet meet the specifications of the diesel version. However, a top speed of 100km/h and range of 200km still makes it a clear distinction in the electric world. The Isik II-E still adopts the same versatility doctrine as the regular Isik II, with a modular turret system and modular armour. One other key versatility feature made specifically for the Isik II-E is a swappable battery pack, allowing the vehicle to extend further than its 200km range, at the expense of having to carry battery packs with it. The cost of manufacture one unit is a slightly more expensive than a regular Isik II, coming in at approximately Ġ800,000, whilst the cost to buy a unit is also more expensive at around Ġ840,000.

The main Hydronian attraction at the 2027 world expo is the OH Isik II-G, a stealthy variant of the base vehicle, which began manufacturing in 2025. The most major difference is the vehicles footprint. It has a slimmer, flatter and overall more streamlined shape to maximise its stealth capabilities and subvert radar. On the topic of radar, the Isik II-G is plated with armour coated in radar-absorbent materials. The Isik II-G uses a combination of ferromagnetic particles and carbon nanotubes to create a high-performing radar absorbent coating. This variant still uses the 4x4 drive and full suspension seen in other models to provide ease of movement over challenging terrain, but the Isik II-G comes much lighter than the other two variants for two main reasons. The first of these is its turrets. The Isik II-G is primarily a reconnaissance vehicle, meaning that it will only need its turret for self-defence. For this reason, OtoHidro decided to reduce the size of the turrets that can be attached to the vehicle to reduce weight. The second reason that makes the Isik II-G lighter is its armour. The armour in this variant is thinner and less protective than the other two variants, allowing for a lighter vehicle at the expense of greater risk to safety, however with the primary task of this vehicle being stealth, the compromise is acceptable. These two things may reduce the vehicles versatility, but the payoff is worth it for the added stealth capabilities it gives it. With the weight reduced, the vehicle can reach up to 120km/h rather than the standard 110, whilst its range sits at about 255km. The Isik II-G has one final feature that allows it to excel in the stealth field, and that is a low-acoustic engine. The Isik II-G sports an engine packed with dampening materials, smoother cylinders and overall quieter components to achieve a level of low sound not seen before in the armoured vehicles industry. Additionally, the engine has a smaller thermal signature thanks to the dampening materials and a more efficient cooling system. The final difference in the Isik II-G comes thanks to a collaboration with Balian Technologies, Hydronias leading military unmanned vehicle manufacturer. Balian have worked to integrate a drone operating system into the Isik II-G. This system comes in the form of a small computer which can display the drones camera footage and control it via an encrypted radio transmitter located on the outside of the vehicle. This provides better reconnaissance capabilities to the Isik II-G, making use of Balians wide range of drones, whilst the radio signals between the drone and vehicle are constantly frequency hopping to avoid interference. This drone technology brings the vehicles crew count up to four, with a drone operator now part of the team. The Isik II-G finds itself at a much higher cost to both manufacture and buy than the other two variants, due to the advanced technologies in play. The cost to manufacture one unit sits at around Ġ950,000, whilst the cost to buy one comes in at Ġ1,000,000, making it an expensive, but highly valuable asset to any modern military.

The side exhibition for Hydronia at the world expo 2027 is run by Balian Technologies, who are showcasing various drones that can be operated from within the Isik II-G. Balian is planning to showcase the aerial capabilities of their drones in an open space outside, so they have requested for such space to be provided for them by Tirakan. The range of drones showcasing at the expo  includes the following:
[list]
[*] CasusHD 1126 FPV (rotors, reconnaissance)
[*] Ölüm 227 FPV (rotors, kamikaze)
[*] Dolu 326 FPV (rotors, small munitions attacks)
[*] Ejderha 725 FW (fixed-wing, long range attacks)
[*] Iğne 1224 FW (fixed-wing, precision strikes)
[/list]

A beforehand request to Tirakan for increased security on its exhibitions as well as a larger space to accommodate the 3 armoured vehicles and an open space to showcase the aerial capabilities of its drones has been made.

Hydronia has used the world expo as a way to showcase their continuously leading role in the armoured vehicle industry, and hopes that governments across the world will look into buying Hydronias top-of-the-line military equipment.
[/spoiler]
